mapper.select: select u.user_id, u.user_name, u.avatar, u.sex, p.bio from sys_user u left join learning_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update sys_user set user_name = #{userName}, avatar = #{avatar,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sex = #{sex}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

insert into learning_user_profile (user_id, bio, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{bio,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update bio = #{bio,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_time = sysdate()
